    ❯❱ php.lang.security.injection.tainted-exec.tainted-exec
          ❰❰ Blocking ❱❱
          User input is passed to a function that executes a shell command.
          Details: https://sg.run/kxEEz

           88┆ exec ("ping -c 4 " . $target, $output, $ret_var);


          Taint comes from:

           84┆ $input = (array) json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), TRUE);


          Taint flows through these intermediate variables:

           84┆ $input = (array) json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), TRUE);

           86┆ $target = $input['target'];


                This is how taint reaches the sink:

           88┆ exec ("ping -c 4 " . $target, $output, $ret_var);
